description: Edit the Shoot Board's brief by hand: add, remove or change looks, or run looks through another automation. Saves a new brief linked to the board and returns the board, the brief, its quote and the credit delta; dry_run only quotes.

BriefDirectionSet.description:
Set the shoot's Direction, the same for every look: the words every shot follows and/or an art
direction (the one left out: none; both left out: nothing directs the shoot and Generate waits for
one, ``slots.UNDIRECTED``). Never changes an automation.

BriefDiscard.description: Take the brief off the board; the only op of its call.

BriefModelsSet.description:
Set the shoot's AI models, the same for every look and step (the one left out: kept). Never
changes an automation: Generate runs its AI model cards on them.

BriefOutputSet.description:
Set this brief's output: a field left out is kept, null follows the board's default (the user's
preferences) again. Every step it is for (a Shoot, a Video, an Upscale) runs and is priced on it.

aspect_ratio.description: e.g. "3:4", "1:1", "9:16": one of the shoot image model's aspect_ratios.

duration.description: Video steps only: the clip's length in seconds, one of the video model's durations (a longer one costs more).

generate_audio.description: Video steps only: true for a clip with sound (only a video model that supports audio), false for a silent one.

resolution.description: e.g. "1K", "2K", "4K": one of the shoot image model's resolutions (a higher one costs more).

upscale_factor.description: Upscale steps only: e.g. 2, 4: one of the upscale model's upscale_factors.

BriefRefresh.description: Re-pin every automation to its current draft (or live version) and price, after it is saved.

BriefRestore.description: Relink a previous draft of this brief (Undo); the only op of its call.

LookAdd.description: Add a look (its key is assigned: the next look_NN).

LookAssignRecipe.description: Run these looks through a recipe of the brief (recipe_key) or another workflow (workflow_id).

workflow_id.description: An automation (one that is not this shoot's own is copied first).

LookFields.description: Who, what and where of one look (all optional; the recipe decides what it needs).

label.description: The look's name, e.g. 'Linen summer set'.

model_id.description: The Model who wears the look.

reference_ids.description: Reference photos (uploaded file ids from the board's References).

LookSet.description: Change some of a look's fields; a field sent as null (or []) is cleared.

fields.description: Any of label, model_id, outfit_id, clothing_ids, location_id, reference_ids.

inputSchema.description: Edit the Shoot Board's brief: ops applied in order, saved as a new brief.

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

dry_run.description: Quote the edit and its credit delta; save nothing.

expected_brief_revision.description: The board's brief_revision shown with the brief.

name: mcp_edit_brief
title: Edit Board Brief
